'''"Quick-draw" Quasar''' was a [[monster droid]] [[racer]] who participated in [[Riot Racing]] on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/faster-episode-guide|text="Faster" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> The [[droid]] combined the body of a [[3PO-series protocol droid]] with the head of a [[B1-series battle droid]].<ref name="Faster" />
